relations.text: Amazon Web Services(AWS)との戦略的協業を発表し、AWSを優先AIクラウド事業者に指名した
relations.text_en: It announced a strategic collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS), naming AWS as its preferred AI Cloud provider

source.label: Fox · April16,2026 preferred AI cloud AWS and deployed Elemental services
source.label_en: Fox · April16,2026 preferred AI cloud AWS and deployed Elemental services
source.quote: “FOX” or the “Company”) today announced a strategic collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS), naming AWS as its preferred AI Cloud provider.

relations.text: FOX SportsとDisney/ESPNは、複数年の権利契約に基づくUFL試合の国内配信パートナーである
relations.text_en: FOX Sports and Disney/ESPN are the domestic distribution partners of the UFL games under multi-year rights agreements

source.label: Fox Corporation 10-K
source.quote: FOX Sports and Disney/ESPN are the domestic distribution partners of the UFL games under multi-year rights agreements.

relations.text: Disney取引後の21CFおよびDisneyとの関係を、分離・配当契約と税務事項契約が定めている
relations.text_en: A separation and distribution agreement and a tax matters agreement govern aspects of the relationship with 21CF and Disney following the Disney Transaction

source.label: Fox Corporation 10-K
source.quote: The Company is party to a separation and distribution agreement and a tax matters agreement that govern certain aspects of the Company’s relationship with 21CF and Disney following the Disney Transaction.

companies.name: モルガン・スタンレー

relations.text: 2026年6月30日、合併契約に関連して、Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc.を管理代理人とするタームローン契約を締結した
relations.text_en: On June 30, 2026, in connection with the Merger Agreement, it entered into a term loan agreement with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. as administrative agent

source.label: Fox Corporation 10-K
source.quote: On June 30, 2026, in connection with the Merger Agreement, the Company entered into a term loan agreement (the “Term Loan Agreement”), among the Company, as Borrower, the initial lenders named therein, and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc., as administrative agent.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
